info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Temporary Access API
List Temporary Accesses for Current User

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the user for which to list temporary access.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`

items.docs: Lists the temporary accesses for the current user.

info.name: Show Temporary Access for Current User

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the user for which to show a temporary access.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`

params.name: temporaryAccessId
params.description: The unique identifier of the temporary access to show.</br>**Example:** `wrm4yyygma4dga6zouiqcaknv4`

items.docs: Shows a temporary access for the current user.

info.name: Revoke Temporary Access for Current User

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the user for which to revoke a temporary access.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`

params.name: temporaryAccessId
params.description: The unique identifier of the temporary access to revoke.</br>**Example:** `0378a782-ca90-11e9-a32f-2a2ae2dbcce4`

items.docs: Revokes temporary access for a user to an organization.

info.name: List Expired and Revoked Temporary Accesses for Current User

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the user for which to list expired and revoked temporary accesses.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`

items.docs: Lists the expired and revoked temporary accesses for the current user.

info.name: List Expired Temporary Accesses for Current User

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the user for which to list expired temporary accesses.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`

items.docs: List the expired temporary accesses for the current user.

info.name: List Active Temporary Accesses for Current User

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the user for which to list active temporary accesses.</br>**Example:** `jsmith@email.com-google`

items.docs: Lists the active temporary accesses for the current user.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: The [unique identifier of the organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/n1ce5273/manage-an-organization/find-your-organization-id) for which to list temporary accesses.</br>**Example:** `mycoveocloudorganizationg8tp8wu3`

items.docs:
Lists the temporary accesses in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"TEMPORARY_ACCESS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
